intro: Today's cross-word puzzle, the twenty-sixth in FUN'S series, is contributed by Charles L. Rives of Spring Valley, N. Y. Mr. Rives writes that he has found it easier to solve one of these puzzles than to originate one and he wonders how many of FUN'S readers will succeed in solving his puzzle.
